description: Rename, reorder or move a folder: name/description edit, display_order to reorder among siblings, parent_collection_id to nest under another folder, clear_parent=true to move back to the root. Grafted codex references (ref_row_id rows) can be renamed and reordered but never moved. Supplied name and description values replace the stored values. An Atlas place (place=true) moves only under another place of its own atlas, and an atlas root stays at the top level.

clear_parent.description: true moves the folder back to the root (mutually exclusive with parent_collection_id)

display_order.description: New sort position among siblings (lower sorts first)

name: chargen_update_collection
title: Update folder
